heartbeat: one timestamped local human-readable line per reconciliation; heartbeat-only checks never wake agents
event_stream: remote events.jsonl when transport is available
notification: append-only REMOTE_TERMINAL event to the Governor inbox; receipt hash is the idempotency key
normal_workflow_role: RunPod long-job monitor only; normal Controller-Director review is synchronous and bypasses Supervisor
legacy_directive_reconciliation: deprecated; available only with --legacy-directive-recovery for historical forensic recovery
controller_wakeup: none; Governor is the sole agent router and delivers each terminal event once
director_trigger: none; Controller ingests and freezes a result before emitting one SHA-bound Governor review event
